context.description: Step 01b (hard gate): Validate CODE-DESIGNER output for IDN-05 before BACKEND-DEV may begin implementation.

task.description:
Validate the IDN-05 design artefact at src/design/idn05-role-registry.md (and companion template specs). Check that:
1. All IDN-05 acceptance criteria are covered with no gaps
2. The design contains NO implementation code (Zig source)
3. The design is complete enough for BACKEND-DEV to implement without ambiguity
4. Migration spec covers the tenant_role table with correct per-tenant scoping
5. GET /roles and POST /roles endpoints are fully specified (auth, request, response, error codes)
6. EE-03 integration path (resolveRoleInTx returning null-on-unbound) is unambiguous
7. Security invariants (tenant isolation, no cross-tenant role leakage) are addressed

Return PASS if all criteria met; FAIL with specific blocking issues if not.

result.summary: All three IDN-05 artefacts validated on rework 1. lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 for all three (src/design/idn05-role-registry.md, templates/specs/idn05-tenant-role.migration.yaml, templates/specs/idn05-roles.crud-endpoint.yaml). codegen_migration.py --dry-run exits 0 and generates correct CREATE TABLE / indexes / test stubs. codegen_crud_endpoint.py --dry-run exits 0 and generates correct handleList/handleCustom handlers with full error-to-HTTP mapping. All IDN-05 acceptance criteria are covered in the traceability table (§12). No Zig implementation code present in the Type E document. Security invariants (parameterised queries, schema-scoped isolation, RBAC before store calls) are specified. BACKEND-DEV may proceed.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) and FRONTEND-DEV (Step 2b) as applicable
